      <article class="q-item">
        <p class="q-text">&ldquo;When you grow up you tend to get told that the world is the way it is&hellip; Life can be much broader once you discover one simple fact: everything around you that you call life was made up by people that were no smarter than you. And you can change it.&rdquo;</p>

        <div class="q-src"><a href="https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Steve_Jobs" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Wikiquote &#8599;</a></div>
      </article>

      <article class="q-item">
        <p class="q-text">&ldquo;Their dreams and my dreams were different. I would never confuse the two of them again.&rdquo;</p>
        <div class="q-attr"><span class="q-who">Larry Ellison</span><span class="q-when">USC commencement, May 13, 2016</span></div>

      </article>

        <p class="q-text">&ldquo;It doesn&rsquo;t matter to me whether we&rsquo;re a pure internet play. What matters to me is: do we provide the best customer service? Internet, shminternet.&rdquo;</p>
